title: Senior Hris Analyst
description:
Job Summary The Senior Manager HR, Administration & Industrial Relations (IR) will be responsible for leading and managing all HR, Administration, and IR functions for two manufacturing companies with a combined workforce of approximately 350 employees, including workmen, staff, engineers, and managers. The role requires strong leadership, statutory compliance, employee relations, workforce planning, and HR strategy to ensure smooth plant operations and organizational growth. Key Responsibilities Human Resources Lead end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, performance management, and employee separation. Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee engagement initiatives. Manage manpower planning, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, and employee records. Handle disciplinary actions, grievance redressal, employee counselling, and domestic enquiries. Drive training, performance appraisal, succession planning, and employee development programs. Industrial Relations (IR) Handle all Industrial Relations activities and maintain harmonious employee relations. Liaise with labour authorities, government departments, and statutory bodies. Manage labour disputes, disciplinary cases, and legal compliance. Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Administration Oversee security, housekeeping, transport, canteen, facility management, and general administration. Manage administrative vendors, contracts, and support services.

Key Skills: Labour Welfare,Contract Labour Management,Labour Laws,IR,Statutory Laws,Labour Relations,Law,Labour
